autoDeleteNonMusic.label: Auto-delete non-music tracks
autoDeleteNonMusic.description: Automatically remove and delete the audio file for any track that audio analysis classifies as non-music, an audiobook, or noise. Turning this on removes any tracks like these already in your library.

nowPlayingPublic.label: Share "now playing" status
nowPlayingPublic.description: Lets a small public API endpoint report the artist and song you're currently listening to — useful for building your own status badge, stream overlay, or bot. It only reports a track while it's actively playing (not paused), and automatically stops reporting shortly after you pause, close the app, or lose connection. Anyone who knows your account email can query it while this is on, so only enable it if you're fine with that.
nowPlayingPublic.usage: Query it with a GET request to:
nowPlayingPublic.exampleResponse: Responds with {"playing": true, "artist": "...", "title": "..."} while something's playing, or {"playing": false} otherwise.

deezer.description: Connect your own Deezer account so this app can fetch missing high-quality (FLAC or 320kbps) tracks directly from Deezer as a last resort, when no other source has them. This only works with an eligible paid Deezer subscription, and only ever downloads tracks your account is already entitled to stream.
deezer.cookieHelper: Copy the value of the "arl" cookie from deezer.com while logged in (your browser's dev tools, under Application/Storage → Cookies). Treat it like a password — anyone with it can download from your account.

qobuz.description: Connect your own Qobuz account so this app can fetch missing high-quality (up to Hi-Res FLAC) tracks directly from Qobuz as a last resort, when no other source has them. This only works with an eligible paid Qobuz subscription, and only ever downloads tracks your account is already entitled to stream.

tidal.description: Connect your own Tidal account so this app can fetch missing high-quality (up to Hi-Res FLAC) tracks directly from Tidal as a last resort, when no other source has them. This only works with an eligible paid Tidal HiFi/HiFi Plus subscription, and only ever downloads tracks your account is already entitled to stream.

deleteTrackConfirm.title: Delete track?
deleteTrackConfirm.message: This permanently deletes the downloaded file for "{{title}}" and removes it from every playlist it appears in, including other users' playlists that share the same file. This can't be undone.

deleteConfirm.title: Remove playlist?
deleteConfirm.message: This will permanently delete "{{name}}" and all its downloaded files. This can't be undone.

generateSimilarConfirm.title: Generate a similar playlist?
generateSimilarConfirm.message: This looks for an alternative or similar track for every song in "{{name}}" (via Last.fm, falling back to remixes/originals on YouTube) and builds a new playlist from the results. It can take a long time for large playlists, and the result is usually smaller than the source, since not every song has a good alternative.

softReimport.title: Soft reimport
softReimport.description: Re-runs title cleanup, MusicBrainz matching, and audio analysis for every track already downloaded in this playlist — no re-download.

tagRebuild.title: Rebuild ID3 tags
tagRebuild.description: Re-writes title/artist/album/track/year/genre ID3 tags on every already-downloaded track in this playlist, using the metadata currently in the database. No network activity, no re-download, no metadata rematch.

originalTitleBackfill.title: Backfill original titles
originalTitleBackfill.description: Re-fetches the raw YouTube title for every track across all playlists whose original title was never saved. No re-download, applies system-wide, not just the selected playlist.

export.title: Export Tracks
export.description: Export a CSV of tracks with their YouTube ID, original YouTube title, artist, and title — useful for bulk-correcting inaccurate metadata with an external tool and reimporting it via Import.
export.sharingUnavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.

import.title: Import Tracks
import.description: Import a CSV in the same format as Export. Matches each row by YouTube ID and updates that track's artist and title — a blank artist or title cell leaves the existing value unchanged. Updated tracks are re-queued for the next HQ scan.

hq.allowedUserProvidersDescription: Lets users connect their own account for these providers from their Profile, as an additional HQ fallback source. Disabling one here hides it from every user's Profile and stops it being used during sync, even for a user who already connected it.
